claims.claim: The New York Times reports Black women, all Democrats, will hold seven of the top eight elected leadership roles in Georgia.
claims.episode_span: will hold seven of the top eight elected leadership roles in Georgia
claims.source_title: The Reward for Black Women’s Work in Georgia: Leaders Who Look Like Them
claims.supporting_quote: Now they’ll hold seven of the top eight elected leadership roles in the state.

claims.claim: Mary-Pat Hector, 28, volunteered on Election Day to help get dozens of voters to the polls and had spent months energizing young people for Democratic candidates.
claims.episode_span: volunteered on Election Day to help get dozens of voters to the polls
claims.source_title: The Reward for Black Women’s Work in Georgia: Leaders Who Look Like Them
claims.supporting_quote: Mary-Pat Hector volunteered on Election Day to help get dozens of voters to the polls in Georgia, and she had spent months doing everything she could to energize other young people to support Democratic candidates.

claims.claim: Hector hoped Keisha Lance Bottoms would win and make Georgia the first state to elect a Black woman as governor.
claims.episode_span: make Georgia the first state to elect a Black woman as governor
claims.source_title: The Reward for Black Women’s Work in Georgia: Leaders Who Look Like Them
claims.supporting_quote: She was hopeful that Keisha Lance Bottoms would win, making Georgia the first state to elect a Black woman as governor.

claims.claim: Hector said she and a mentor cried on the phone because they had been doing the work for so long and could see the fruits of their labor.
claims.episode_span: We both just cried on the phone
claims.source_title: The Reward for Black Women’s Work in Georgia: Leaders Who Look Like Them
claims.supporting_quote: “We both just cried on the phone,” Ms. Hector, 28, said, “because we have been doing this work for so long.”

claims.claim: Private William Douglas Dal Bianco of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry, died Friday in Ontario from injuries in the October CFB Wainwright fire, the fifth soldier to die of those injuries.
claims.episode_span: died Friday in Ontario from injuries sustained in an October fire
claims.source_title: Fifth soldier dies from injuries after October fire at CFB Wainwright
claims.supporting_quote: Private William Douglas Dal Bianco, of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry, died on Friday in Ontario

claims.claim: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced the death on Saturday.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced the death on Saturday
claims.source_title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies following military base fire
claims.supporting_quote: A fifth Canadian soldier, William Douglas Dal Bianco , died on Friday from injuries sustained in an October military base fire, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced on Saturday.

claims.claim: NPR reports Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and weakened GOP dominance in others, with health care access and school-voucher limits on the agenda.
claims.episode_span: took control of legislatures that had been divided
claims.source_title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
claims.supporting_quote: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

claims.claim: A Copa Airlines Boeing 737 wingtip struck the nose of a UPS Boeing 767 around 9 p.m. Saturday at Miami International Airport.
claims.episode_span: struck the nose of a UPS Boeing 767
claims.source_title: Two Planes Collide on a Taxiway at Miami International Airport
claims.supporting_quote: The wingtip of a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck the nose of a UPS Boeing 767 around 9 p.m., according to the Federal Aviation Administration, which is investigating.

claims.claim: Controllers told the UPS crew to give way; the Copa flight had arrived from Panama City and the UPS flight was bound for Bogotá; two people had minor injuries and operations were not disrupted.
claims.episode_span: controllers had told the UPS crew to give way
claims.source_title: Two Planes Collide on a Taxiway at Miami International Airport
claims.supporting_quote: Air traffic controllers had told the UPS crew to give way to the Copa flight, the F.A.A. said.

claims.claim: Just over two months earlier an Amazon cargo jet overran a runway at the same airport, struck two vehicles and killed five people.
claims.episode_span: an Amazon cargo jet overran a runway at the same airport
claims.source_title: Two Planes Collide on a Taxiway at Miami International Airport
claims.supporting_quote: The collision came just over two months after an Amazon cargo jet overran a runway at the same airport, striking two vehicles and killing five people.

claims.claim: Researchers with direct knowledge of Pan American Health Organization deliberations say the United States has lost measles elimination status.
claims.episode_span: lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated
claims.source_title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
claims.supporting_quote: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

claims.claim: Carney pledged forest funding reported as C$560 million and as up to $392.5 million over four years, announced with Lula at the ASEAN summit in Manila, toward a facility aiming at a $125 billion fund.
claims.episode_span: up to $392.5 million over four years
claims.source_title: Canada pledges $392.5M to Brazil-led global forest fund
claims.supporting_quote: Canada has pledged up to $392.5 million over four years to the Brazilian-led Tropical Forests Forever Facility

claims.claim: Carney says Canada expects trade with the Philippines to triple over the next decade after free-trade talks concluded with President Marcos on November 14.
claims.episode_span: expects trade with the Philippines to triple over the next decade
claims.source_title: Carney says Canada expects trade with PH to triple over next decade
claims.supporting_quote: Carney says Canada expects trade with PH to triple over next decade

claims.claim: About 2,500 Canadian troops are stationed in Latvia, where Canada leads a NATO multinational brigade, and Carney said Europe's security architecture will be set by a free Europe and NATO, not Russia.
claims.episode_span: About 2,500 Canadian troops are stationed in Latvia
claims.source_title: Europe and NATO will determine their own security, not Russia - Canadian Prime Minister Carney
claims.supporting_quote: The prime minister noted that approximately 2,500 Canadian troops are stationed in Latvia . Canada also leads a NATO multinational brigade there.

claims.claim: Judge Ana C. Reyes on Saturday temporarily blocked the Trump administration from closing East Potomac Park and required courses, paths and picnic areas to stay open to the public.
claims.episode_span: temporarily blocked the administration from shuttering the park
claims.source_title: Judge Blocks Immediate Closure of East Potomac Park for Trump Golf Project
claims.supporting_quote: A federal judge on Saturday temporarily blocked the Trump administration from shuttering East Potomac Park in Washington

claims.claim: NPR reports the judge ordered a two-week delay to any work at the Washington public golf course.
claims.episode_span: a two-week delay to any work
claims.source_title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
claims.supporting_quote: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

claims.claim: SpaceX caught Starship at its Texas launchpad by lowering the spacecraft until two metal arms on the launch tower secured it.
claims.episode_span: two metal arms attached to the launch tower secured it
claims.source_title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
claims.supporting_quote: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

claims.claim: A bomb found Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria was rendered safe; officials called it a credible threat and the FBI is investigating.
claims.episode_span: BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria
claims.source_title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
claims.supporting_quote: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

claims.claim: Delray Beach canceled its St. Patrick's Day parade after nearly 60 years, citing a Florida law barring taxpayer dollars for diversity initiatives.
claims.episode_span: canceled its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run
claims.source_title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
claims.supporting_quote: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

claims.claim: Mexico News Daily reports President Trump threatened to double tariffs over a migrant caravan.
claims.episode_span: threatened to double tariffs over a migrant caravan
claims.source_title: Mexico’s week in review: Trump renews tariff threats as Sheinbaum prepares for China
claims.supporting_quote: Trump threatened to double tariffs over a migrant caravan
